name: pam_shibboleth
detailed_description: PAM module for Shibboleth SAML IdP integration. Enables authentication through Shibboleth federation, commonly used in academic institutions for inter-institutional authentication.
notes:
Federation authentication for academic institutions. Requires Shibboleth infrastructure.
